title: 18th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/18/2024).

From the Speaker's desk: the President's nominee for Governor of the Maldives Monetary Authority, under Article 6(3) of the MMA Act (Law No. 6/81), is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
Unfinished business: continuing the debate on the bill to amend the Criminal Procedure Act (Law No. 12/2016), submitted on behalf of the government by Manadhoo MP Husnee Mubarik.

Unfinished business: continuing the debate on the bill to amend the Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters Act (Law No. 2/2015), submitted on behalf of the government by Holhudhoo MP Abdul Sattar Mohamed.
Unfinished business: continuing the debate on the bill to amend the Maldives Legal Profession Act (Law No. 5/2019), submitted on behalf of the government by Hulhumalé North MP Hussain Shareef.

Committee business: report of the Government Oversight Committee on the President's submission, under Article 116(a) of the Constitution, seeking Majlis approval of the ministries created on 17 November 2023 and their mandates.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting sent the President's MMA Governor nominee to committee, continued three bill debates, and took up the oversight committee's report on approving the government's ministries.
